title: Composite module-sheaf maps vanish sectionwise
statement: For module sheaves M,N,P on a scheme X and morphisms f:M→N and g:N→P, the composite f;g is zero if and only if g(f(x))=0 for every open U and every section x of M on U.

source.place: Elementary sheaf morphism extensionality used after the local fraction-chart calculation.

proof.text: One direction follows by applying equality of morphisms to each section. Conversely, sectionwise equality gives equality of module-sheaf morphisms by Scheme.Modules.hom_ext and extensionality of the section homomorphisms.

from.place: Proof step 3: global sheaf extensionality after local chart comparison.

lean.statement: theorem comp_zero_iff_forall_section_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N P : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) : f ≫ g = 0 ↔ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(M, U)), g.app U (f.app U x) = 0
